name: MonarchDivider
title: Separator
summary: A 1dp line that separates content, horizontal or vertical.
whenToUse: Between groups of content that are not already separated by space or a surface.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDivider(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, orientation: MonarchDividerOrientation = MonarchDividerOrientation.Horizontal)

states.name: default
states.description: A 1dp line in the default border color.

appearance: The default border color of the theme; stronger in the high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Named MonarchDivider on Android and iOS, after the platform controls; the web calls it Separator.
accessibility: Decoration only: it has no semantics and TalkBack skips it.
edgeCases: A vertical divider takes the height of its parent, so the parent needs a bounded height, for example Row(Modifier.height(IntrinsicSize.Min)).

examples.title: Horizontal
